attributes.name: Druva - Backup Encryption Disabled
attributes.description: Detects administrative activity indicating backup encryption was disabled.
author: Druva
false_positives: Temporary configuration change during a documented maintenance activity.
Replacement of the existing encryption configuration with another approved control.
attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and druva.event_type:"Backup Encryption Disabled"
attributes.note:
### Investigation guide

This rule detects administrative activity indicating that Druva backup encryption was disabled. Disabling encryption can reduce protection of backup data, but the detected behavior does not cleanly correspond to a current Enterprise ATT&CK technique and is therefore intentionally left without an ATT&CK mapping.

#### Investigation steps

- Identify the administrator, source IP, affected workload or configuration, and timestamp.
- Determine whether the change was approved and whether an alternative encryption control was introduced.
- Review nearby security-setting, repository, permission, retention, storage-target, and protection changes.
- Review authentication and privilege activity by the responsible administrator.
- Determine whether backups were created or transferred while encryption was disabled.
- Confirm whether encryption was subsequently restored.

#### Response

- Restore required encryption controls.
- Investigate unauthorized changes and the responsible administrator account.
- Assess exposure of backup data created or handled while encryption was disabled.
